seo.title: Glide-Out Cabinet Shelves, Built to Fit
seo.description: Custom glide-out shelves installed into the cabinets you already own. Measured on site, built to the sixteenth, installed in a single visit.

sections.heading: Keep your cabinets. Reach the back.
sections.body: We build glide-out shelves for the cabinets you already have. Every shelf is measured in your kitchen and cut to that opening, so the back corner stops being storage you never reach.

sections.heading: A local shop that measures before it builds.
sections.body:
For fifteen years we have fitted glide-out shelves into the kitchens of the valley, and in that time we have built more than 12,000 of them. One trade, done well: we measure the cabinet you already own, build to that exact opening, and install it in a single visit without tearing anything out.

Every shelf is cut in our own shop by the same people who measured it. No subcontractors, no stock sizes trimmed to fit, no second trip. If a shelf ever stops gliding, the team that built it comes back and sets it right.

sections.heading: We keep them gliding for good.
sections.body: A glide-out shelf takes a decade of daily use. When a runner needs adjusting or a soft-close wears out, we come back and set it right rather than sell you a replacement. Every installation carries a lifetime warranty on the glides, and a tune-up is only a phone call away.

image.alt: Full-extension glide-out shelf holding ceramic dishes

bullets.desc: Runners, bearings and soft-close dampers are covered for as long as you own the cabinet.
We re-level shelves and swap worn dampers on site, in a single visit.
The people who built your shelves are the ones who come back to service them.

sections.heading: Spread the cost over months, not one bill.
sections.body: A full retrofit does not have to be a single bill. Approved buyers can finance the work with low monthly payments and 0% APR for the first twelve months, so you get the kitchen now and pay for it over time.

image.alt: Kitchen with a dark island and glide-out storage

bullets.desc: Manageable instalments sized to your budget, with 0% APR for the first twelve months.
Apply in minutes and see your rate with no impact on your credit score.
Clear the balance whenever you like, without a penalty for paying early.
